summary: Iter38: Fixture module CRUD (end_date validation, double_matchday legacy ignore, save/edit/delete, GET /fixtures, GET /fixtures/{id}/matches) + cross-app dd/mm/yyyy date format verification. All backend and frontend flows working.

results.test_generate_end_date_too_early: PASS - end_date<last_match returns 400 with 'fecha fin' in detail
results.test_saved_fixture_appears_in_list: PASS - POST /fixtures/generate save returns UUID, GET /fixtures includes entry with team_ids/start_date/end_date/category/group_name
results.test_double_matchday_ignored: PASS - double_matchday=true with rounds=2 produces 1 round per day (different dates per matchday), legacy field ignored
results.test_delete_fixture: PASS - DELETE /api/fixtures/{id} returns matches_deleted>=1; subsequent list excludes it

frontend_tests_executed.AdminFixtureGenerator_DOM: PASS - [data-testid=fg-double-matchday-label] absent; fg-start-date + fg-end-date present; end-date min attr equals selected start; saved-fixtures-section present
frontend_tests_executed.Saved_fixtures_table: PASS - row data-testid=saved-fixture-{id}, edit + delete buttons present; Inicio/Fin columns rendered as dd/mm/yyyy (e.g. 15/10/2026, 31/12/2026)
frontend_tests_executed.Fixture_editor_open: PASS - clicking saved-fixture-edit-{id} opens [data-testid=fixture-editor] with editor-row-{mid}, editor-date-{mid}, editor-venue-{mid}, editor-save-{mid}
frontend_tests_executed.Fixture_editor_persist: PASS - editor-date changed from 2026-10-15T10:00 to 2026-11-25T09:00; after page reload the new value persists
frontend_tests_executed.Fixture_delete: PASS - clicking saved-fixture-delete-{id} triggers window.confirm; on accept toast 'Fixture eliminado (1 partidos)' shown and row removed

cross_app_date_format./fixture: PASS long-form '1 DE FEBRERO DE 2026' via formatDateLong + times HH:MM
cross_app_date_format./datos-estadisticas: PASS (no toLocaleString leaks; no finished matches with dates in current dataset)
cross_app_date_format.toLocaleString_leak_check: NONE found across all 10 scanned pages

frontend_tests_executed.regression: PASS - no console pageerrors during testing; only a benign React hydration warning about <span> inside <option> in AdminFixtureGenerator (pre-existing, caused by the dev instrumentation wrappers, not a real bug)

critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/fixtures `active_matches` uses an $or over team_ids without filtering by status, so the count includes finished matches as well — the saved-fixtures table column label is 'Partidos' (count) so this is fine, but if it's intended to mean 'partidos vivos' (scheduled-only) per the inline comment, add status:'programado' to the count_documents query.

DELETE /api/fixtures only removes matches with status='programado' but the matches_deleted message shows just the count — the UI confirm warns 'los finalizados se conservan'. Behaviour matches comment; OK.
Hydration warning: AdminFixtureGenerator <option> contains a <span> wrapper injected by dev instrumentation (x-source-* attrs) — affects DOM hygiene only in dev mode; harmless in production builds.
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up 4 transient fixtures via API + UI: TEST_Grupo_Iter38, TEST_SavedFix_Iter38, TEST_DblIgn_Iter38 (preview only), TEST_DelFix_Iter38, TEST_FE_Iter38, TEST_FE2_Iter38. All saved fixtures explicitly deleted at the end of the run. db.fixtures should be empty again.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter38 verified the full fixture lifecycle (preview→edit→save→edit-persisted→delete) and the global dd/mm/yyyy date formatter helpers (/app/frontend/src/lib/dateFormat.js). Backend persists fixture metadata in db.fixtures collection. The frontend route is /admin/generador-fixture. Tournament categories ('2009', '2010', etc.) don't match team categories ('Sub-12', 'Sub-8') in current seeded data — when testing fixture generation, pick any non-archived tournament + any team category with 2+ teams; the backend does not validate that the category exists in the tournament's categories list at generation time (only updates rules when saving).
